name: NASA Technical Standard 5009C — Nondestructive Evaluation Requirements for Fracture Critical Metallic Components
description: Nondestructive evaluation (NDE) requirements applicable to fracture-critical metallic components.

rules.title: Fracture-critical classification
rules.text: Components designated fracture-critical shall be identified on the work order and inspected per the applicable NDE method; this designation cannot be waived by operations.

rules.title: Inspector certification
rules.text: NDE inspectors shall hold current certification for the method being applied; sign-off records shall include inspector certification reference.
